arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hydra
print('workspace import:', hydra.__file__)
assert Path(hydra.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(Path.cwd().resolve())
from hydra.utils import instantiate
from omegaconf import OmegaConf
class User:
    def __init__(self,name):self.name=name
class Parent:
    def __init__(self,user_config):self.user=instantiate(user_config)
for as_list in (False,True):
    cfg=OmegaConf.create({"username":"alice","foo":{"username":"${username}"},"node":{"_target_":"__main__.Parent","_recursive_":False,"user_config":{"_target_":"__main__.User","name":"${foo.username}"}}})
    if as_list:cfg.node=[cfg.node]
    original=OmegaConf.to_container(cfg,resolve=False)
    result=instantiate(cfg.node[0] if as_list else cfg.node)
    print(as_list,result.user.name)
    assert result.user.name=="alice"
    assert OmegaConf.to_container(cfg,resolve=False)==original
PYREPLAY
